title: H<SUB>2</SUB> molecular gas absorption-selected systems trace CO molecular gas-rich galaxy overdensities
question: Search for CO molecular gas emission from the host galaxies of H2-bearing UV absorption-selected systems at z <= 1 and identify whether the absorbing gas traces extended galaxy disks or dense gas pockets in the circum-galactic/intra-group medium.

recipe.goal: Image ALMA spectral cubes and continuum
recipe.method: Image pipeline-calibrated uv-data sets using tclean with natural weighting, a field of view of 1.5 times the primary beam, and 15-20 km s^-1 channel width.
key_parameters: field of view = 1.5 x primary beam (1.4' in Band 3, 1.2' in Band 4)

recipe.goal: Search for CO line emission and classify detection confidence
recipe.method: Search for CO line emission in non-primary-beam-corrected image cubes both visually by-eye and using the line finder software SoFiA. Flag detections with FWHM < 300 km s^-1 as low significance (L) unless confirmed by independent observations, and FWHM >= 300 km s^-1 (or confirmed) as high significance (H).
key_parameters: FWHM threshold = 300 km s^-1 for high/low confidence flag

recipe.goal: Extract CO spectra and measure line fluxes and upper limits
recipe.method: Extract CO spectra from primary beam corrected image cubes by integrating over the region defined by the 3 sigma contour in the integrated flux map. For non-detections, calculate 5 sigma upper limits assuming a 300 km s^-1 linewidth.
key_parameters: extraction aperture = 3 sigma contour in integrated flux map
upper limit threshold = 5 sigma over 300 km s^-1 linewidth

recipe.goal: Derive CO luminosities and molecular gas masses
recipe.method: Convert observed CO line luminosities to CO(1-0) luminosity using Milky Way type line ratios from Carilli & Walter (2013), and multiply by a Galactic CO-to-H2 conversion factor alpha_CO = 4.36 M_sun (K km s^-1 pc^2)^-1.
assumptions: LambdaCDM cosmology with H_0 = 70 km s^-1 Mpc^-1, Omega_m = 0.3, Omega_Lambda = 0.7
Milky Way type CO excitation ladder (Carilli & Walter 2013; r_32 = 0.54 from Bolatto et al. 2013)
alpha_CO = 4.36 M_sun (K km s^-1 pc^2)^-1 (including 1.36 helium factor)

recipe.goal: Measure ionized gas SFR, depletion time, and kinematics from archival MUSE data for HE 0515-4414 G1
recipe.method: Search archival MUSE cube of HE 0515-4414 for [OII] emission from CO-detected galaxies, compute non-dust-corrected SFR following Kennicutt (1998) and corresponding molecular gas depletion time, and compare line-of-sight velocity maps of CO(3-2) and [OII].

recipe.goal: Test for galaxy overdensities and correlations between absorber and host galaxy properties
recipe.method: Integrate the Fletcher et al. (2021) CO luminosity function above 10^9 K km s^-1 pc^2 over the ALMA Band 3 and 4 co-moving volume within +/- 1000 km s^-1 to estimate expected background galaxy counts; test for correlations between N(HI), N(H2), f_mol, impact parameter, and host M_mol.
key_parameters: L'_CO integration lower limit = 10^9 K km s^-1
velocity range = +/- 1000 km s^-1 from z_abs
assumptions: CO luminosity function from Fletcher et al. (2021)
